events.title: River Run

host.name: London City Runners
host.about: A free running club based at the Marquis of Wellington pub in Bermondsey. Social membership is free.

sessions.note: All paces. Easy group (about 6:30 per km) leaves at 6:45pm.
Routes head east. No bag drop on Sundays.

events.summary: Free group runs along the Thames, three times a week, from Bermondsey.
events.about: Weekday runs head west along the river to Millennium Bridge (about 6.5k), Blackfriars Bridge (8k) or Westminster Bridge (11k) and back. Sunday runs head east: about 6.5k, 10k to Greenland Pier, or 18k through the Greenwich foot tunnel and back over Tower Bridge. Social membership is free: make a profile on the club's website, then turn up.
events.meta_description: Every Tuesday, Thursday and Sunday at The Marquis of Wellington, Bermondsey, SE1. Free. Free group runs along the Thames, three times a week, from Bermondsey.
